1 .  Criteria

12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - ONE of the following:  
 
 1.1 Patient is 10 years of age or younger  
 
OR

UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 765 
 
 1.2 ALL of the following:  
 
  1.2.1 Patient is greater than 10 years of age  
 
AND 
 
  1.2.2 Diagnosis of proliferating infantile hemangioma  
 
AND 
 
  1.2.3 Prescriber provides a reason or special circumstance the patient cannot use generic 
propranolol oral solution
